scripts.studio: npm run prepare-assets && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs
scripts.preview: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts TUEMotion out/tue-motion-preview.mp4 --scale=0.5 --codec=h264 --crf=20
scripts.render: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts TUEMotion out/tue-motion-4k.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.pilot-preview: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts TUEMotion out/ultimo-sinal-parte-1-preview.mp4 --props=examples/ultimo-sinal-parte-1.json --frames=0-719 --scale=0.5 --codec=h264 --crf=20
scripts.pilot-full: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts TUEMotion out/ultimo-sinal-parte-1-completo.mp4 --props=examples/ultimo-sinal-parte-1.json --scale=0.5 --codec=h264 --crf=20
scripts.pilot-qc: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts TUEMotion out/ultimo-sinal-8-cenas-qc.mp4 --props=examples/ultimo-sinal-qc.json --scale=0.5 --codec=h264 --crf=20
scripts.pilot-master: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts TUEMotion out/ultimo-sinal-parte-1-4k.mp4 --props=examples/ultimo-sinal-parte-1.json --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.actor-demo: npm run prepare-assets && remotion render src/index.ts LuminoActorTest out/lumino-personagem-remotion.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --concurrency=2
